field_reference.name: Short 2-6 word task name for the footer dock
field_reference.command: Shell command to start in the background
field_reference.isAgent: true only for LLM/agent processes (like child pi -p ...); false for scripts, tests, servers
field_reference.description: Optional human-readable context for the task
field_reference.timeoutSeconds: Optional timeout; task is failed and killed when exceeded
field_reference.notifyOnCompletion: Whether to deliver completion notification (default: true)
field_reference.triggerOnCompletion: Whether to automatically start a follow-up agent turn on completion (default: true for bg_run)
